qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow (JRF-01 to 03): Master's degree in Geophysics/ Marine Geophysics/ Applied Geology/ Applied Geophysics/ Marine Geophysics or equivalent. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in the relevant subject from a recognized university with at least 60% marks. CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) / Ph. D Only or GATE qualified. Work/ research experience in the field of marine geological/ geophysical data analysis. Hands-on experience with programming languages such as Fortran / Python / C++ / MATLAB etc. Junior Research Fellow (JRF-02): Master's degree in Marine Science/ Oceanography/ Physical Oceanography/ Atmospheric Science/ Oceanography/ Physical Oceanography or Bachelor's degree in Engineering/ Technology in the relevant subject from a recognized university or equivalent with at least 60% marks. CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) / Ph. D Only or GATE qualified. Experience in Oceanographic and atmospheric data analysis and numerical modelling. Experience in programming such as MATLAB/ Python/ FERRET etc. Junior Research Fellow (JRF-03): Master's degree in Chemistry/ Marine Chemistry/ Chemical Oceanography / Marine Sciences/ Hydrochemistry/ Environmental Sciences or equivalent. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in the relevant subject from a recognized university with at least 60% marks. CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) / Ph. D Only or GATE qualified. Work/ research experience in the field of chemical oceanography, marine sciences and marine chemistry / geochemistry. Hands-on experience with sample preparation and analysis of seawater for chemical composition, including Nutrients, dissolved trace gases, trace metals, and their isotopes.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NCPOR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCPOR Junior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the online interview is 07 September 2026. For the walk-in interview, candidates should report on 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in a relevant discipline or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology with at least 60% marks and must be qualified in CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or have a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow posts at the National Centre for Polar & Ocean Research.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for the NCPOR Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply through a Walk-in Interview. For online interviews, applications must be submitted via email by the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the location for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at Vasco-da-Gama, Goa, with the pincode 403804.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Junior Research Fellow positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Temporary.
